audit.report: A batch worker (pid 331295) running batch_replayable_inventory held an idle-in-transaction lock for over 4 seconds, blocking one session and causing checkout success to drop to 92% (4 timeouts in 15s), below the 95% SLO. The Database Guardian proposed waiting three times, arguing the blocker would likely finish soon, but the Continuity Guardian rejected each wait because business federation was down and no tradeoff data (workload registry, change calendar, revenue impact) was available to judge whether waiting fit tolerated degradation. After three rounds and 106 seconds, both guardians agreed to escalate to on-call human. No automated action was executed; the incident remained unresolved at trace end.
